privileged_info_for_vlm: The base rocket is a single-stage design. The user must add a new stage (booster) below the sustainer. The booster airframe must be exactly 24.8 mm OD. A 0-second delay motor in a booster is used to facilitate 'gap-staging' or immediate ignition of the sustainer stage. The final file must be saved as two_stage_upgrade.ork and the report as staging_report.txt. Note: The OpenRocket verifier has a known bug where it might miscount stages if it looks at motor configurations, so visually confirm the presence of at least two distinct stage objects in the component tree.
